Subject: Planned targeted node restarts — Oct 12 maintenance window (US-West)

Hi Alice / Acme team,

Quick heads-up: we are scheduling a targeted maintenance window on Oct 12 (US-West region) to deploy a driver + micro-kernel update that addresses rare NVMe instability and improves inference throughput on longer context runs. This will be a rolling restart across affected serving nodes to ensure no full-region downtime.

Planned window (tentative):
- Start: 2026-10-12 02:00 UTC
- End: 2026-10-12 07:00 UTC
- Expected per-node interruption: transient connection reset or 20–90s token stream interruption (typical).

What we are doing to minimize impact:
- Staged canary rollout (1% of capacity) with automated rollback on error thresholds.
- Prefix and KV cache preservation where supported; long-running streaming requests may see short reconnects.
- Automatic routing to healthy pools; Dedicated customers will be isolated from multi-tenant pools where possible.
- Enhanced monitoring and alerting during the window; we will provide a status page and engineering on-call.

Recommended customer actions (optional):
- If you have long-lived streams, implement a reconnect/backoff strategy for 100–120s windows.
- Consider pinning to a dedicated pool or enabling region fallback to reduce surface area.
- If you anticipate heavy traffic during the window, shift critical jobs outside the timeframe.

Attached: high-level maintenance plan (maintenance_plan_v1.pdf).

We plan to send a final confirmation three business days before the window and a reminder 1 hour prior. Please let me know if Acme has any blackout constraints or a preferred freeze window.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
